faq.title: About the daily rashifal
faq.note: This is a general reading shared by everyone born with the Moon in {name}.

items.q: Is this horoscope based on my Sun sign or Moon sign?
items.a: Vedic astrology reads the daily horoscope (rashifal) from your Moon sign — the sidereal sign the Moon occupied at your birth. It often differs from your Western Sun sign.

We take today’s real planetary positions from the Swiss Ephemeris (Lahiri ayanamsha) and count each graha from your Moon sign, applying the classical gochara tables of favourable houses and Vedha (obstruction) from BPHS and Phaladeepika. The Moon’s transit carries the most weight for a single day.

items.q: How do I find my Moon sign?
items.a: Enter your birth date, time and place in the free Vedaansh birth chart. Your Moon sign (Chandra Rashi) appears in the chart summary.
